about_item: 3D Embroidered Spooky-Chic Design:​ Elevate your decor with these unique ghost pillow covers. Set against a soft white base, featuring tactile 3D embroidered ghosts with delicate black embroidered eyes, the raised stitching creates a lifelike texture that balances cozy warmth with a playful, spooky-chic vibe.

Luxuriously Soft Faux Fur Touch:​ Crafted from premium plush faux fur, these decorative cushion covers offer an irresistibly soft and cozy hand-feel. The fluffy texture invites warmth, making them perfect for snuggling on the couch or adding tactile luxury to your retreat.

Spooky Neutral Vibe:​ Elevate your Halloween decor with this ghost pillow. Its soft matte finish brings ghostly charm to any space while blending into modern minimalist, rustic farmhouse, and neutral interiors. Ideal for sofa, porch, or bedroom — hauntingly cute without overpowering your decor.

Handcrafted Quality & Fit: Set of 2 pillow covers, each measuring 18"x18" (inserts not included). Features a discreet invisible zipper for easy insert swaps. As each piece is hand-cut and hand-sewn, please allow a slight 1–2 cm deviation.

Durable & Easy Care:​ Sturdy stitching ensures lasting durability. Machine wash cold separately on a gentle cycle and tumble dry low to maintain the plush fur's softness and the embroidery's vibrant look.

authors_reviews.title: Soft, cute, well made — I’d buy more
authors_reviews.text: These are even cuter in person. They arrived clean and protected in a resealable zip-top bag, which I really liked. You don’t have to cut the packaging open, so I’m keeping the bags to store the covers in after Halloween.Right out of the package they were extremely soft. There was a very subtle new-fabric smell, but nothing strong or unpleasant. The raised ghosts are actually fluffy and dimensional, rather than just being a printed design, and the black embroidered faces give them a really cute 3D look. The back has a smooth, almost suede-like feel.The covers feel sturdy and the stitching looks good. The zipper is small and discreet, so you really don’t notice it when it’s closed. Looking at the inside, I did notice a few loose ends from the black embroidery, but they don’t affect the appearance from the outside.One thing I wish they had included is a care-instruction tag. There isn’t one sewn into the covers, so you’ll need to refer back to the listing, which says to machine wash cold on gentle and tumble dry low.I also agree with the listing’s “spooky neutral” description. They’re Halloween-themed without being bright or overly cartoonish, so they’re easy to work into regular home decor. The listing mentions using them on a porch, but personally I wouldn’t. The white plush material and embroidery feel much better suited to indoor use, especially if you want to keep them looking nice.I bought the 18x18 set of two, and I would absolutely buy more for my other throw pillows. I especially like that there are different sizes and colors available, so I can mix and match while keeping the same ghost theme.For the price I paid, I’m very happy with the quality. Cute, ridiculously soft, and exactly the kind of Halloween decor I was looking for. 👻
